title: Settings
subtitle: Game location, appearance, automation and privacy.

game.title: Rocket League
game.folderHint: Detected automatically for Epic and Steam. Pick it manually if needed.

keys.title: Game files
keys.presentHint_one: {{count}} key loaded — item swaps and custom decals are enabled.
keys.presentHint_other: {{count}} keys loaded — item swaps and custom decals are enabled.
keys.missingHint: Without keys.txt, item swaps and custom decals are disabled. Maps, palette and tracker still work.
keys.dropInHint: Pick your keys.txt (it is copied into the app data folder), or drop it there yourself.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.fxHint: Animated aurora background. Low halves the GPU cost.
appearance.pauseInGameHint: Stops all animation when Rocket League is in the foreground.

automation.title: Automation
automation.reapplyHint: Rebuilds your swaps, palette and decals from the new game files automatically.
automation.restoreMaps: Restore maps when the game closes
automation.restoreMapsHint: After an offline session, the stock map is put back so online play stays clean.

privacy.title: Privacy & safety
privacy.local: Everything runs locally: your catalog comes from your own game files.
privacy.noInjection: Nothing is injected into the game process.
privacy.noInterception: Game traffic is never intercepted: no certificates, no proxy, no hosts file.
privacy.reversible: Every file change is recorded with a verified backup and can be undone.
privacy.diagnosticsHint: Creates a local zip (logs + settings) you can share if you need help. Nothing is uploaded.

stock.title: Restore the stock game
stock.hint: Removes every change the app made to the game files. Useful if something looks wrong.
stock.confirmBody: The game goes back to its original files.
stock.listPalette: The colour palette goes back to stock
stock.listMap: The active custom map is removed
stock.kept: Your presets, palettes, decal packs and map library are kept — you can re-apply them anytime.
